name: vrx-mm
description: MM (Marketing Materials) — the developer-side authoring app. Assembles buildings/units/texts/media → previews → exports a valid VRX ingest-pack ZIP. Separate workspace from the portal (S230). Slice 1 = the Structured face (textual foundation + units.csv import + validation rail + ZIP export).
